--- import type { HTMLAttributes } from "astro/types" import ArrowRightIcon from "@lucide/astro/icons/arrow-right" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge" import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon" import { Section, SectionContainer, SectionTitle, } from "@/components/ui/section" type Props = HTMLAttributes<"section"> & { badge: string title: string description: string services: { icon: string title: string description: string link?: { label: string href: string } }[] } const { class: className, badge, title, description, services, ...props } = Astro.props ---
{badge} {title}

{description}

{services.map((service) => (

{service.title}

{service.description}

{service.link && ( {service.link.label} )}
))}
